feeds.title: The Vienna Blog
feeds.description: This is a Travel and Lifestyle Blog about Vienna and beyondTheViennaBlog launched in April 2010, when its author, Greg Sideris, decided to publish his vast travel knowledge to benefit friends, family and the wider online community.

feeds.title: Chronic Wanderlust
feeds.description: Find helpful travel itineraries for your next travel adventure. Here you'll find exhilarating stories, tips on what to do where, where to eat, where to stay and more!

feeds.title: Escape Town
feeds.description: The Austrian travel journalist Lea Hajner writes worldwide about outdoor and winter sports, adventure, hiking and sustainable lifestyle. With inspiring photos & practical travel tips!

feeds.title: Creativelena Blog
feeds.description: Creativelena's Travel Blog is just what you are looking for! Roaming my own home country Austria for great local pieces of advice, I also report on my travels around Europe, Asia, South America and Australia / New Zealand in both English and German with focus on culinary, creative & curious travel stories.

feeds.title: Rick Steves' Travel Blog » Austria
feeds.description: Guidebook author and travel TV host Rick Steves is America's most respected authority on European travel.

feeds.title: Sommertage
feeds.description: Personal travel blog from Austria. We'll tell you our best tips for individual trips around the world. On our travel blog, we share with you our passion for travelling and photography. Both adventures from afar and those right on our doorstep.

feeds.title: Lilla Green
feeds.description: LillaGreen is a travel blog from Austria which gives you useful tips and advice on how to travel the world better.

feeds.title: Austrian Adaptation Blog
feeds.description: I'm Carly, an Aussie living in Vienna who loves travel, brunch, local adventures. Here's where I share stories & advice about life in Vienna, loving an Austrian and the places we discover on our part-time travels.This blog's for other folks who want to make the most of their time in Austria and never waste brunch in a bad cafe.
